messages:
nina_sales: Heads-up team 10x bank wants a short POC but with hard EU-only residency: no US subprocessors, BYO-KMS, and deterministic routing (no automatic global failover). Need clear artifact pack for legal + security: list of EU regions we can serve from, current subprocessors in-EU-only or attestations, routing policy snippet we can show them, and a POC pricing delta. Deadline Wed EOD.

 tom_sre: We can host in eu-west-1, eu-central-1, and eu-west-3 for this POC. Note: S3-like storage in eu-west-1 (via AWS) and object-storage in eu-west-3 (GCS) — both have EU data residency controls. Monitoring is Datadog EU tenancy but ops/admins may have support access from non-EU locations; we need vendor attestation. I can generate a short latency/throughput note for their expected token qps.

 leah_se: BYO-KMS flow: supported on Dedicated and Private. Customer provides key material endpoints (KMS ARN) + trust role. We wrap with envelope encryption; we never import raw key material. For Hosted theres an additional network hop; encryption-at-rest still in-customer-key envelope. Drafting a sample curl + trust policy. Also flag: BYO-KMS invokes compliance review (approx 7-10 biz days) so call that out to the customer.

 dan_presales: Pricing: geo-pin feature is a configuration add-on. For a 30-day POC add-on I'd price +12% on top of their reserved POC rate. If they accept Dedicated multi-month we can discount the geo-pin to +5% for the first quarter. Strict EU-only (no global fallback) requires capacity reservation and is +22%. I'll prepare two quotes: (1) lenient EU-preference with standby EU failover, (2) strict EU-only with no cross-border fallback.

 compliance_bot: Automated check: third_party_monitoring=Datadog (EU region available). Created ticket CMP-2026-88 requesting vendor EU-only access attestation and support access SOP. ETA 4 business days. Also flagged requirement: subprocessor contract addendum may be necessary.

 omar_ops: Operational note: tenant pinning stops autoscale from placing tokens outside pinned regions. We can configure a standby EU failover (eu-central-1 as warm standby). If customer wants no standby, we must pre-warm capacity in each region which increases cost and increases lead time. Also, control-plane telemetry: if they require control-plane completely inside VPC, escalate to Security for a Private deployment path.

 nina_sales: Action list: (1) @tom_sre finalize region list + perf numbers, (2) @leah_se share BYO-KMS runbook + example IAM/trust, (3) @dan_presales publish two POC quote variants and note waived-fee options, (4) @compliance_bot/@security get Datadog attestation & subproc addendum. Need everything by Wed EOD to hit vendor timeline.

 tom_sre: Confirmed regions: eu-west-1, eu-central-1, eu-west-3. Sample routing snippet below to show them policy behavior: 
```
policy: "pin_to_region": true,
"primary_region_group": "EU",
"standby_within": "EU",
"global_fallback": false
```

 leah_se: Uploaded initial BYO-KMS runbook draft to the shared drive, will paste cURL sample and IAM trust into this thread in ~1h.

 dan_presales: Draft quotes in flight. I'll include conditional waiver language if they convert to Dedicated within 60 days. Sending to thread shortly.

 compliance_bot: CMP-2026-88 updated: vendor attestation requested from Datadog EU team. Noted that support staff access may be from non-EU IPs; legal will advise on acceptable mitigations.

 nina_sales: Thanks all. Once we have the attestation + runbook + quote I'll consolidate and send to 10x bank. :thumbsup:
